text:
Alice: DeployBot alerted: lease exhaustion on migration mig_4423 during tenant-shard-swap 18:42 UTC. Holding window.
DeployBot: [deploybot] MIGRATION_LEASE_WARN mig_4423 shard=shard-17 lease_owner=deploybot worker=pool-7
DeployBot: logs: ```ERROR: lease renewal failed: timeout; inflight 12/16; queue depth spike```
Brian: On it. can we force-extend lease or do a manual pause? @DeployBot what are safe ops?
DeployBot: safe_ops: pause, cancel, extend(30s). auto-fallback -> rollback if lease lost >60s
Carla: I'd prefer pause + snapshot then resume after draining inflight. rollback is costly for this tenant range.
Dinesh: Agree pause. How to snapshot quick? small script: ```pg_dump -t tenant_shard_17 --data-only --where='tenant_id in (...)' > /tmp/shard17.dump``` not ideal under load
Alice: Ops priority: 1) pause canary shards 2) capture KV cache snapshot (Runtime hook) 3) if inflight > 20 -> rollback
Brian: I can run pause now. Doing: ```deploybot pause mig_4423 --reason "lease spike" --actor brian``` will report back
Brian: ran pause command, deploybot acked :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: [deploybot] PAUSE_ACK mig_4423 by brian at 1769996685
OpsBot: Note: roll-forward risk if pause >10m, will trigger autoscaler and may affect other jobs :warning:
Carla: started snapshot; ETA ~90s. tagging run in runbook https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/migrations#mig_4423
Dinesh: after snapshot we should attempt extend(30s) once inflight drains to <8, else rollback.
Alice: decision: Pause + snapshot + extend probe. if extend fails -> escalate rollback on call.
Brian: copying to release notes: "mig_4423 paused for lease anomaly; snapshot taken; probing extension" will pin version to v1.12.4 for this window
Carla: snapshot done, checksum OK. DeployBot suggested extend probe.
Brian: running extend probe: ```deploybot extend mig_4423 --secs 30``` ... DeployBot: EXTEND_OK
DeployBot: [deploybot] EXTEND_OK mig_4423 by brian at 1769996712
Alice: resuming canary slowly with ratecap 0.2. monitor trace and token rates. :eyes:
Dinesh: will watch locks and queue depth, ready to abort for rollback.
Carla: leaving postmortem stub in #postmortems and mark release notes as pinned.
Brian: thanks all. closing thread after 10m if stable.
